issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: One could argue the compiler-synthesized UnspecifiedInitial merely reflects an unauthored default and that collision_avoidance_deactive being the sole entry point of the narrative is self-evident, but the exact owner-local edge required by NL12 is absent and cannot be inferred from the synthetic placeholder.
issues.title: CollisionAvoidanceSystem initial pseudostate does not enter collision_avoidance_deactive

issues.basis: NL12/NL13 segments describing collision avoidance behavior; fcstm_model.model_ir.text root shows only '[*] -> AutonomousMode : /Autonomous_mode_start;' with CollisionAvoidanceSystem declared as a sibling composite with no incoming edge; verify_facts.checks non_proved reachability rows for CollisionAvoidanceSystem, collision_avoidance_deactive, collision_avoidance_active; inspection_equivalent_facts.diagnostics STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL entries.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidanceSystem, as a top-level operating composite required to run alongside AutonomousMode (NL12/NL13 describe an always-active collision avoidance subsystem), must be reachable from the model root so its states and transitions can execute.
issues.observed: verify_facts.checks.non_proved lists reachability:state:CollisionAvoidanceSystem:line:67 as refuted with reachable_from_initial=false; inspection_equivalent_facts diagnostics STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL for CollisionAvoidanceSystem, collision_avoidance_deactive, and collision_avoidance_active; the FCSTM root only has '[*] -> AutonomousMode' with no edge to CollisionAvoidanceSystem.
issues.reason: NL12 and NL13 describe a fully specified operating subsystem (collision avoidance) with two states and two transitions that must actually execute as part of the overall system; the closed model's root only enters AutonomousMode, leaving the entire CollisionAvoidanceSystem composite, and consequently its required initial_entry and event-consumer obligations, unreachable. This is a distinct causal reachability property not captured by the initial_entry or transition_endpoint contracts already extracted, matching the frontier discipline for deriving a narrowest global reachability contract when a required operating composite is topologically isolated.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state. It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met...
issues.strongest_rebuttal: NL does not explicitly use the word 'reachable' or 'root', so one could argue this is an unstated structural assumption rather than an explicit obligation; however the entire behavior described in NL12/NL13 is inexecutable without root reachability, making this a genuine causal consequence of the described operating behavior.
issues.title: CollisionAvoidanceSystem composite is unreachable from the model root

issues.basis: NL2 quote; fcstm_model.model_ir.text transitions at lines 64-65; smt_facts contains no formula for these events (only R45RouteToken guards at lines 59-62); inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions confirms separate trigger lists with no guard field.
issues.expected: The two alternatives from InitialState must be distinguishable/mutually exclusive so exactly one fires under any reachable variable valuation.
issues.observed: FCSTM transitions tr(line:64) InitialState->HighwayMode triggers=[high_way_true] and tr(line:65) InitialState->UrbanMode triggers=[urban_way_true] are two independent boolean events with no declared exclusivity constraint or shared guard structure in the closed model; no SMT/verify fact establishes disjointness of high_way_true and urban_way_true.
issues.reason: NL2 explicitly requires the two alternatives to be based on distinguishing conditions; guard_disjointness has no frozen predicate and must remain a W1 candidate when the closed model does not exhibit an explicit joint guard structure proving exclusivity.
issues.requirement_quote: can transition to either HighwayMode or UrbanMode based on conditions: `high_way=true` for HighwayMode or `urban_way=true` for UrbanMode
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Since high_way_true and urban_way_true are modeled as distinct atomic events (not a shared boolean variable), an event-based semantics may guarantee natural exclusivity by construction (only one event fires at a time), which would satisfy disjointness without an explicit guard predicate.
issues.title: HighwayMode/UrbanMode alternatives from InitialState lack an explicit mutual-exclusion guarantee

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions transition:line:71 source=[*] target=UnspecifiedInitial scope=CollisionAvoidanceSystem; working_contract.elements.compiler_owned includes compiler:state:...CollisionAvoidanceSystem.UnspecifiedInitial as a synthetic_state; exact_source_inventory has no explicit initial-state marker line for collision_avoidance_deactive under CollisionAvoidanceSystem.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidanceSystem's owner-local initial pseudostate edge ([*] -> ...) must enter collision_avoidance_deactive.
issues.observed: The closed FCSTM shows CollisionAvoidanceSystem's initial edge (transition:line:71) targets a compiler-synthesized 'UnspecifiedInitial' state, not collision_avoidance_deactive; collision_avoidance_deactive has no incoming initial edge at all.
issues.reason: NL12 explicitly establishes collision_avoidance_deactive as the initial state of the collision avoidance system (owner). The exact closed model's CollisionAvoidanceSystem-owned initial edge (transition:line:71) resolves to state:UnspecifiedInitial:line:70, a compiler-owned synthetic placeholder, per working_contract element compiler:state:...UnspecifiedInitial. This is a distinct wrong-target defect on the owner-local initial_entry obligation, independent from the separate root-reachability defect on the whole composite.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: One could argue the synthetic UnspecifiedInitial is merely a parser placeholder for an unparsed/absent authored edge rather than a deliberate wrong target, but regardless of cause, the exact owner-local edge required by NL12 to reach collision_avoidance_deactive is absent, and the actual edge that exists targets a different state.
issues.title: CollisionAvoidanceSystem owner-local initial edge targets a synthetic UnspecifiedInitial state, not collision_avoidance_deactive

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts.states state:CollisionAvoidanceSystem:line:67 reachable_from_initial=false; verify_facts.checks.non_proved reachability check for state:CollisionAvoidanceSystem:line:67; inspection_equivalent_facts.diagnostics STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL for line 67/68/69/70 and EVENT_CONSUMER_UNREACHABLE for the pedestrian/front_inactive events.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidanceSystem, the owner of the required collision-avoidance operating behavior, must be reachable from the top-level machine root so its transitions can execute at runtime.
issues.observed: inspection_equivalent_facts marks state:CollisionAvoidanceSystem:line:67 with reachable_from_initial=false; verify_facts.checks.non_proved lists reachability:state:CollisionAvoidanceSystem:line:67 as status=refuted; no source or closed-model transition targets CollisionAvoidanceSystem from AutonomousMode, the root wrapper, or any reachable state; its declared consumer transitions (collision_avoidance_deactive->collision_avoidance_active and back) are correspondingly EVENT_CONSUMER_UNREACHABLE.
issues.reason: NL12/NL13 describe an active operating subsystem with reachable initial and toggling behavior, presupposing that the subsystem is part of the executing system; the closed model isolates CollisionAvoidanceSystem entirely from the root reachability graph, which is a global structural defect distinct from and not discharged by the individual endpoint or initial-entry contracts.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state. It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met...
issues.strongest_rebuttal: CollisionAvoidanceSystem could be intended as an independently-running orthogonal region outside AutonomousMode's tree with its own implicit top-level entry, in which case the missing edge might be a diagram-level omission rather than a semantic root-reachability defect; however, the closed model's only top-level entries are to AutonomousMode, and no structural region separator or concurrent-region declaration establishes CollisionAvoidanceSystem as a parallel root region.
issues.title: CollisionAvoidanceSystem composite is not reachable from the machine root

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts.event_consumers row for event pedestrian_detected_...; declared_ref/consumer_transition_refs=[transition:line:72], reachable_consumer_transition_refs=[]; verify_facts.checks.non_proved event-consumer:pedestrian_detected_... status=refuted.
issues.expected: The activation transition endpoint must exist and be operationally reachable so the declared danger-response behavior can occur.
issues.observed: The exact transition (transition:line:72, source=collision_avoidance_deactive, target=collision_avoidance_active) exists structurally with the correct trigger, but inspection_equivalent_facts.event_consumers for the pedestrian/danger event shows reachable_consumer_transition_refs=[] while consumer_transition_refs=[transition:line:72], and verify_facts confirms event-consumer check status=refuted; this is caused by the unreachable enclosing CollisionAvoidanceSystem scope.
issues.reason: The endpoint exists structurally, matching NL12's stated source/target/trigger, but because the enclosing CollisionAvoidanceSystem scope is unreachable from root, the transition can never fire at runtime; this is preserved as the behavioral consequence of the same endpoint obligation rather than silently treated as satisfied.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The endpoint itself is present and correctly formed (source, target, and trigger all match NL12), so a strict reading of transition_endpoints as pure edge existence is satisfied; the operational unreachability is arguably fully captured by the separate derived reachability contract rather than this endpoint contract.
issues.title: collision_avoidance_deactive -> collision_avoidance_active transition exists but is operationally unreachable from root

response.basis: Numbered NL segments NL1, NL2, NL11, NL13 and primary typed plan/transition_groups list.
response.reason: Reviewed all 13 numbered NL segments against the primary plan's 39 contracts and 8 transition groups. Most independently violable obligations (containment, initial entry, endpoints, disjointness, termination) are already captured. Gaps found: (1) NL2's InitialState-to-HighwayMode/UrbanMode group lacks containment rows for HighwayMode and UrbanMode under AutonomousMode, since NL1/NL2 establish AutonomousMode as the continuing enclosing owner of InitialState, HighwayMode, and UrbanMode (the primary plan only contains InitialState-in-AutonomousMode); (2) NL4/NL5 lane_change-to-exit_highway and cruise-to-exit_highway alternatives are missing their transition_groups rows (the primary plan has endpoint contracts NL4-ENDPOINT-1/2 and NL5-ENDPOINT-1/2 but no corresponding transition_groups entries were provided for NL4 and NL5 sources with combined alternatives -- wait these do exist as NL-GROUP-NL4-1 and NL-GROUP-NL5-1, already present); (3) NL9's group is present but the containment for straight-to-intersection is already covered; (4) NL11 cross-mode dynamic transitions lack a guard_disjointness or event_consumer_coverage contract, but more importantly a transition_groups entry for NL11 (HighwayMode/UrbanMode dynamic transitions) is missing from the primary plan's transition_groups list, even though endpoint contracts exist; (5) NL12/NL13 collision avoidance deactivate/active endpoints lack a transition_groups entry for NL13 (collision_avoidance_active source) and the collision avoidance subsystem's initial_entry lacks an explicit containment contract if it is a substate of a named parent -- but NL12 doesn't establish a parent, so skip. Also NL10 UrbanMode termination lacks a corresponding transition_groups row, but termination groups are not typically required as transition_groups per schema (they're single-target). After careful review, the most solid gaps are: missing containment contracts placing HighwayMode and UrbanMode within AutonomousMode (established by NL1's introductory sentence and NL2's parallel treatment of InitialState/HighwayMode/UrbanMode as AutonomousMode substates), and a missing transition_groups entry for NL11's bidirectional HighwayMode/UrbanMode alternation and for NL13's collision_avoidance_active source.
